title: 推理工作流事件 / Reasoning Workflow Event
description: 可重放的推理事件联合类型，包含因果、幂等、尝试次数和字段级来源。/ A replayable discriminated union of reasoning events with causation, idempotency, attempts, and field-level provenance.

schema_version.title: 模式版本 / Schema version
schema_version.description: 本事件契约的语义版本。/ Semantic version of this event contract.

event_version.title: 事件版本 / Event version
event_version.description: 事件实例结构的版本。/ Version of the event instance structure.

workflow_id.title: 兼容工作流标识 / Compatibility workflow identifier

event_type.title: 事件类型 / Event type
event_type.description: 用于判别 payload 的不可变事件类型。/ Immutable event type that discriminates the payload.

event_processing_status.title: 事件处理状态 / Event processing status

workflow_state.title: 权威工作流状态 / Authoritative workflow state

parent_event_id.title: 父事件标识 / Parent event identifier

candidate_path_id.title: 候选路径标识 / Candidate-path identifier

sequence_number.title: 序列号 / Sequence number
sequence_number.description: 工作流内单调递增的事件序列号。/ Monotonically increasing event sequence within a workflow.

attempt_number.title: 尝试次数 / Attempt number
attempt_number.description: 同一逻辑操作的尝试编号。/ Attempt number for the same logical operation.

tool_call_id.title: 工具调用标识 / Tool-call identifier
tool_call_id.description: 工具调用事件必须提供。/ Required for tool-call events.

human_work_id.title: 人工工作标识 / Human-work identifier
human_work_id.description: 人工工作事件必须提供。/ Required for human-work events.

field_provenance.title: 字段来源 / Field provenance
field_provenance.description: 逐字段记录来源、完整性和值状态。/ Records source, integrity, and value state for individual fields.

payload.title: 事件载荷 / Event payload
payload.description: 统一使用 kind 与 data，并由 event_type 同时约束二者。/ Always uses kind and data, both constrained by event_type.

Identifier.title: 稳定标识 / Stable identifier
Identifier.description: 工作流内稳定且可引用的标识。/ A stable, referenceable identifier within a workflow.

NullableIdentifier.title: 可空标识 / Nullable identifier
NullableIdentifier.description: 不适用时为 null，否则为稳定标识。/ Null when not applicable; otherwise a stable identifier.

SemanticVersion.title: 语义版本 / Semantic version
SemanticVersion.description: 契约或记录的语义版本。/ Semantic version of a contract or record.

Sha256.title: SHA-256 哈希 / SHA-256 hash
Sha256.description: 带算法前缀的十六进制完整性哈希。/ A hexadecimal integrity hash with an algorithm prefix.

SafeExternalValue.title: 安全外部值 / Safe external value
SafeExternalValue.description: 递归拒绝私密推理字段名，仅允许可外部审计的数据。/ Recursively rejects private-reasoning field names and permits only externally auditable data.

SafeExternalPropertyName.title: 安全外部字段名 / Safe external property name
SafeExternalPropertyName.description: 大小写不敏感地拒绝私密推理字段名。/ Rejects private-reasoning property names case-insensitively.

WorkflowState.title: 权威工作流状态 / Authoritative workflow state
WorkflowState.description: 执行状态机使用的唯一状态枚举。/ The sole state enumeration used by the execution state machine.

EventProcessingStatus.title: 事件处理状态 / Event processing status
EventProcessingStatus.description: 事件所描述操作的处理状态，不替代工作流状态。/ Processing status of the operation described by an event; it does not replace workflow state.

ValidationOutcome.title: 验证结果 / Validation result
ValidationOutcome.description: 验证器的权威结果枚举。/ Authoritative outcome enumeration for validators.

VersionedBinding.title: 版本化绑定 / Versioned binding
VersionedBinding.description: 将引用绑定到标识、版本和内容哈希。/ Binds a reference to identifier, version, and content hash.

BindingState.title: 绑定状态 / Binding state
BindingState.description: 显式区分已观测绑定与候选形成前缺失、未知或不适用的绑定。/ Explicitly distinguishes an observed binding from a binding missing, unknown, or not applicable before candidate creation.

Causation.title: 因果上下文 / Causation context
Causation.description: 支持分布式追踪、事件因果和父子跨度。/ Supports distributed tracing, event causation, and parent-child spans.

Actor.title: 事件主体 / Event actor
Actor.description: 发出或负责该事件的版本化主体。/ Versioned actor that emitted or owns the event.

ObservedValue.title: 显式值状态 / Explicit value state
ObservedValue.description: 分别表示有值、零、缺失、未知和不适用，避免用 null 混淆语义。/ Separately represents present, zero, missing, unknown, and not-applicable values instead of overloading null.

ObservedNumber.title: 显式数值状态 / Explicit numeric state
ObservedNumber.description: 数值专用的显式状态包装。/ Explicit state wrapper specialized for numeric values.

KnownCount.title: 已知计数 / Known count
KnownCount.description: 严格区分正整数计数与观测零值。/ Strictly distinguishes a positive integer count from an observed zero.

ObservedCount.title: 显式计数状态 / Explicit count state
ObservedCount.description: 计数专用状态包装，保留零、缺失、未知和不适用的差异。/ Count-specific state wrapper preserving the difference between zero, missing, unknown, and not applicable.

KnownRate.title: 已知比率 / Known rate
KnownRate.description: 零到一之间的已知比率，并显式表示零值。/ A known ratio between zero and one with an explicit zero representation.

ObservedRate.title: 显式比率状态 / Explicit rate state
ObservedRate.description: 比率专用状态包装，保留零、缺失、未知和不适用的差异。/ Rate-specific state wrapper preserving the difference between zero, missing, unknown, and not applicable.

PositiveLimitValue.title: 正数限制值 / Positive limit value
PositiveLimitValue.description: 预算限制只能为正数；未配置或未知时使用显式状态，禁止观测零值。/ A budget limit must be positive; unconfigured or unknown limits use explicit states and observed zero is forbidden.

FieldProvenance.title: 字段来源记录 / Field provenance record
FieldProvenance.description: 字段来源、版本、完整性以及不可混淆的值状态。/ Field source, version, integrity, and unambiguous value state.

ResourceValue.title: 资源值 / Resource value
ResourceValue.description: 用显式状态区分观测数值、观测零值、缺失、未知和不适用。/ Uses explicit state to distinguish observed numbers, observed zero, missing, unknown, and not applicable.

Resources.title: 资源观测 / Resource observations
Resources.description: 工作流事件的各维度资源观测，禁止将异构单位相加。/ Per-dimension resource observations; heterogeneous units must not be summed.

UnifiedPayload.title: 统一事件载荷 / Unified event payload
UnifiedPayload.description: 由事件类型判别的载荷类别和结构化数据；运行时不得写入私密思维过程。/ Payload kind and structured data discriminated by event type; runtimes must not write private chain-of-thought.

ReasoningConfiguration.title: 推理配置 / Reasoning configuration
ReasoningConfiguration.description: 独立描述执行调度、推理深度和拓扑。/ Independently describes scheduling, reasoning depth, and topology.

EvidenceBinding.title: 证据绑定 / Evidence binding
EvidenceBinding.description: 绑定到证据版本和哈希。/ Binding to evidence version and hash.

ClaimBinding.title: 声明绑定 / Claim binding
ClaimBinding.description: 描述证据与声明之间的关系。/ Describes the relationship between evidence and a claim.

Evidence.title: 证据 / Evidence
Evidence.description: 绑定到候选结果和执行契约的版本化证据。/ Versioned evidence bound to a candidate and execution contract.

record_hash.description: 完整证据事件记录的可重算摘要。/ Reproducible digest of the complete evidence event record.

predecessor_evidence_binding.description: 候选绑定证据修订所来源的步骤证据记录绑定。/ Step-evidence record binding from which a candidate-bound evidence revision derives.

StepRecord.title: 可闭合步骤记录 / Closable step record
StepRecord.description: 仅记录外部可核验的步骤摘要、证据和验证绑定，不记录私密思维过程。/ Records only externally verifiable step summaries, evidence, and validation bindings, never private chain-of-thought.

record_hash.description: 当前步骤事件记录的可重算摘要。/ Reproducible digest of the current step event record.

ValidationFinding.title: 验证发现 / Validation finding
ValidationFinding.description: 验证器产生的结构化发现。/ Structured finding emitted by a validator.

ValidationResult.title: 验证结果 / Validation result
ValidationResult.description: 绑定到特定候选、证据集合、验证器和契约的不可混用验证结果。/ A non-transferable validation result bound to a specific candidate, evidence set, validator, and contract.

details_hash.description: 外部可公开验证详情的内容哈希，不包含私密推理。/ Content hash of externally disclosable validation details; it excludes private reasoning.

WorkflowStartedPayload.title: 工作流启动载荷 / Workflow-started payload
WorkflowStartedPayload.description: 绑定启动时采用的规范化输入。/ Binds the normalized input used to start the workflow.

StateChangedPayload.title: 状态变更载荷 / State-changed payload
StateChangedPayload.description: 记录权威状态转换及原因码；消费方必须校验 from_state/to_state 与信封 previous_state/next_state 一致，且 workflow_state 等于 to_state。/ Records an authoritative state transition and reason code; consumers must verify from_state/to_state match envelope previous_state/next_state and workflow_state equals to_state.

RouteSignalValue.title: 路由信号值 / Route signal value
RouteSignalValue.description: 与推理契约相同的显式状态路由值。/ Explicit-state routing value shared with the reasoning contract.

RoutingSignal.title: 类型化路由信号 / Typed routing signal

RoutingReason.title: 类型化路由原因 / Typed routing reason

RouteSelectedPayload.title: 路由结果载荷 / Route-selected payload
RouteSelectedPayload.description: 记录策略版本、选择的推理配置和结构化路由信号。/ Records policy version, selected reasoning configuration, and structured routing signals.

ModeSwitchedPayload.title: 模式切换载荷 / Mode-switched payload
ModeSwitchedPayload.description: 记录允许列表内的推理配置切换。/ Records a reasoning-configuration switch allowed by the contract.

BudgetUpdatedPayload.title: 预算更新载荷 / Budget-updated payload
BudgetUpdatedPayload.description: 使用显式数值状态记录预算预留、消耗、退款或释放。/ Records budget reservation, consumption, refund, or release with explicit numeric states.

BudgetDimensionSnapshot.title: 预算维度快照 / Budget-dimension snapshot
BudgetDimensionSnapshot.description: 一个预算维度的限制、累计消耗和剩余额度。/ Limit, cumulative consumption, and remaining capacity for one budget dimension.

BudgetVectorUpdatedPayload.title: 原子预算向量更新 / Atomic budget-vector update
BudgetVectorUpdatedPayload.description: 在一条事件中记录原子多维预留、消费或释放，避免部分维度事件丢失。/ Records an atomic multi-dimensional reservation, consumption, or release in one event so dimensions cannot be partially lost.

ToolCallPayload.title: 动作载荷 / Action payload
ToolCallPayload.description: 动作阶段、种类、执行器版本、实时验证授权绑定和输入输出指纹。/ Action phase, kind, executor version, live-verified authorization bindings, and input/output fingerprints.

HumanWorkPayload.title: 人工工作载荷 / Human-work payload
HumanWorkPayload.description: 人工升级请求、完成、过期与新运行恢复记录；human_work_id、task_id、run_id 和 contract_binding 位于事件信封。/ Human-escalation request, completion, expiry, and new-run resumption records; human_work_id, task_id, run_id, and contract_binding live in the event envelope.

TerminalPayload.title: 终态载荷 / Terminal payload
TerminalPayload.description: 工作流终态、原因码以及可选结果绑定。/ Workflow terminal state, reason code, and optional result binding.

TaskPayload.title: 任务事件载荷 / Task event payload
TaskPayload.description: 绑定任务和其接收或规范化阶段。/ Binds a task and its received or normalized stage.

ContractEstablishedPayload.title: 契约建立载荷 / Contract-established payload
ContractEstablishedPayload.description: 绑定已建立的执行契约及其输入。/ Binds the established execution contract and its input.

CandidatePayload.title: 候选结果载荷 / Candidate payload
CandidatePayload.description: 绑定新候选、契约、证据集合聚合哈希和生成该候选的逐项证据。/ Binds a new candidate, its contract, the aggregate evidence-set hash, and the individual evidence used to produce it.

evidence_record_bindings.description: 候选所使用完整证据记录的版本与记录哈希绑定。/ Version and record-hash bindings of the complete evidence records used by the candidate.

CandidateComparedPayload.title: 候选比较载荷 / Candidate-comparison payload
CandidateComparedPayload.description: 记录被比较候选、选择规则和可选胜出候选。/ Records compared candidates, selection rule, and optional selected candidate.

IterationClosedPayload.title: 迭代关闭载荷 / Iteration-closed payload
IterationClosedPayload.description: 记录迭代编号、候选绑定和可度量信息增益。/ Records iteration number, candidate binding, and measurable information gain.

ValidationStartedPayload.title: 验证启动载荷 / Validation-started payload
ValidationStartedPayload.description: 在执行验证前绑定验证器、候选、证据和契约。/ Binds validator, candidate, evidence, and contract before validation executes.

BudgetExhaustedPayload.title: 预算耗尽载荷 / Budget-exhausted payload
BudgetExhaustedPayload.description: 记录耗尽维度、限制、消耗和契约规定动作。/ Records exhausted dimension, limit, consumption, and contract-prescribed action.

BudgetRuntimeExhaustedPayload.title: 原子预算拒绝载荷 / Atomic budget-rejection payload
BudgetRuntimeExhaustedPayload.description: 当一次原子多维操作被拒绝时，记录尝试向量、拒绝前快照和契约动作。/ Records the attempted vector, pre-rejection snapshot, and contractual action when an atomic multi-dimensional operation is rejected.

NoProgressPayload.title: 无进展限制载荷 / No-progress-limit payload
NoProgressPayload.description: 记录连续无进展步数、阈值和观测信息增益。/ Records consecutive no-progress steps, threshold, and observed information gain.

OutcomePayload.title: 结果回接载荷 / Outcome payload
OutcomePayload.description: 记录推理结果与独立结果来源的绑定。/ Binds a reasoning result to an independently sourced outcome.

GovernancePayload.title: 治理决策载荷 / Governance-decision payload
GovernancePayload.description: 记录风险、决策和版本化治理策略。/ Records risk, decision, and versioned governance policy.

ProtectedTransition.title: 受保护转换 / Protected transition
ProtectedTransition.description: 反馈规则所保护的确定状态转换和负责人。/ Deterministic state transition and owner protected by a feedback rule.

FeedbackExemption.title: 反馈豁免 / Feedback exemption
FeedbackExemption.description: 绑定批准人、授权、范围、期限、补偿控制以及使豁免失效的输入、契约、候选和规则版本。/ Binds approver, authority, scope, expiry, compensating controls, and the input, contract, candidate, and rule versions whose change invalidates the exemption.

FeedbackPayload.title: 探针反馈载荷 / Probe-feedback payload
FeedbackPayload.description: 统一记录反馈提出、确认、解决和豁免；事件信封 idempotency_key 必须由 feedback_id 与 revision 稳定派生。/ Uniformly records feedback raised, acknowledged, resolved, and exempted; the envelope idempotency_key must be stably derived from feedback_id and revision.

resolution_authority_binding.description: 授权该阻断反馈解除的当前权限授予。/ Current authority grant authorizing removal of the blocking feedback.

ProbeHealthPayload.title: 探针健康载荷 / Probe-health payload
ProbeHealthPayload.description: 记录可重建事件丢失、重复、乱序、解析、计算和告警送达的探针健康窗口；计数恒等式由消费方校验。/ Records a probe-health window that reconstructs event loss, duplication, disorder, parsing, calculation, and alert delivery; consumers validate count identities.
